raw_message: Hi, I tried logging in this morning and keep getting a 403 error. My account is arcvault.io/user/jsmith. This started after your update last Tuesday.

enrichment.core_issue: The customer cannot log in and receives a 403 error.

summary: The customer reports being unable to log in, receiving a 403 error on account arcvault.io/user/jsmith after the recent update on Tuesday. The Engineering team should investigate the login failure and error code 403 as a high‑priority bug. No escalation to Human Review is needed.
